children: The Graph's Subgraph Studio traffic migration moves queries to The Graph Network, starting with BNB Smart Chain and Polygon, with an October 8, 2026 deadline. Subgraphs still using staging endpoints must be published, and their query traffic must switch to Gateway endpoints.

The migration routes query fees and indexing rewards to GRT Indexers and Delegators, connecting Studio usage on these chains to network revenue accrual. Query-fee volume and Indexer participation on BNB Smart Chain and Polygon provide the first measures of that transition. These measures track actual usage and participation rather than the endpoint switch alone.
Developer traffic moves onto The Graph Network, Indexers who serve now earn the rewards, and the Foundation steps in as operator to grow the network.

title: The Graph: Subgraph Studio moves traffic to The Graph Network - 08 Oct 2026
